name: Sequentum MCP
description: Sequentum is the trusted execution layer for AI workflows and mission-critical web data. Our platform delivers deterministic web scraping, web search, and crawling at enterprise scale, with browser orchestration and web automation built on 18 years of mission-critical infrastructure. Agent Builder turns a natural language prompt into a production-ready web data agent in minutes. The Visual Editor takes it to atomic-level precision. From AI training data, agentic checkout flows, and real-time web search to compliance-grade research pipelines, Sequentum turns the web into reliable, actionable data that hedge funds, Fortune 500s, and government agencies trust.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sequentum MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sequentum MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sequentum.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sequentum MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sequentum MCP lists 39 MCP tools, including create_agent_schedule, delete_agent_schedule, delete_run, disable_agent_schedule, enable_agent_schedule, get_agent, get_agent_build_status, get_agent_cost_breakdown, get_agent_runs, get_agent_runs_cost, get_agent_schedule, and get_agent_versions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sequentum MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sequentum MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Sequentum MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sequentum MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sequentum MCP is developed by Sequentum. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
